answer: Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 15 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. The vine debit happens at intake, juniper totals the burned amount, and dawn anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm thus pays the burn once for every alias on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. Honest users pay that once, farms 32 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
